acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Void Horrors family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Crawler, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Missing-Step Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Low scuttling Crawler of too many thin matte-black limbs with no face and no reflection.
Signature mechanic: Unfinished Step: too many thin limbs scuttle in sequence, but one missing contact makes the body hesitate before the low rake.
battlefieldDuty: Probe timing with one scuttling route whose final thin limb appears to skip a contact point.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 faceless thin limbs, missing edge, and no reflection gain one external pressure gauge; T2 the face-hole rim gains a directional channel; T3 the eye orbit and star interior gain vector brackets; T4 the partial contour and negative limb gain bounded still markers; T5 the eye-ring and unresolved absence gain one external pressure interval.

Motion/process branches: T1 the thin-limb missing edge directs debris around one still external gauge; T2 the face-hole rim vents through its channel; T3 eye-orbit pauses redirect star-interior vectors; T4 the partial negative limb moves between still markers; T5 the unresolved eye-ring redirects and stills one pressure interval.
counterplay: Cross the missing-contact side and strike the paused thin-limb edge before the rake resumes. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the faceless thin-limb missing edge with no reflection exposes its still external pressure gauge; T2 the face-hole rim exposes its still channel after venting; T3 the eye orbit and star interior expose the vector anchor between releases; T4 the partial negative limb exposes the bounded still marker; T5 the unresolved eye-ring exposes its pressure interval at the still center.
identityInvariants: Rough humanoid or many-limbed absence retains edges that fail to close while proportions shift only within readable tier silhouettes.
Matte void black, negative space, purple-black, star flecks, and one bounded cold eye accent remain source grammar rather than affinity evidence.
Absence, non-reflection, star-field interior, fractured geometry, eye rings, and geometric shards never resolve into ordinary flesh or matter.
Power subtracts coherence: later forms occupy less resolvable physical presence while telegraph anchors become deliberately sparse.
telegraph: Three limb tips align while a fourth open edge stops moving against the floor without reflection.
